T1.implementation_approach: Use a component-based framework to design an intuitive and responsive interface for browsing, searching, and filtering problems.
T1.notes: Focus on user experience and accessibility.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem creation, retrieval, update, and deletion.
T2.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Design normalized tables to store problem metadata, tags, and difficulty levels.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a form-based interface for users to submit code with syntax highlighting and file upload options.
T4.notes: Include real-time feedback for syntax errors.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a sandboxed environment to execute user-submitted code and compare outputs against test cases.
T5.notes: Ensure security and prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page displaying user details, progress, and achievements.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage user data, including profile updates and progress tracking.
T7.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user data.

T8.implementation_approach: Design tables to store user information, progress, and achievements.

T9.implementation_approach: Create a leaderboard interface displaying top users based on various metrics.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to fetch leaderboard data and update rankings dynamically.

T11.implementation_approach: Design an interface to display hints and solutions for problems.
T11.notes: Ensure hints are displayed progressively to avoid spoiling solutions.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and solutions, including retrieval and updates.
T12.notes: Ensure proper access control for solutions.

T13.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests to verify problem library functionality.
T13.notes: Focus on edge cases and performance testing.

T14.implementation_approach: Test code submission and evaluation system for correctness and security.

T15.implementation_approach: Verify user profile updates and progress tracking functionality.

T16.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for accuracy and real-time updates.
T16.notes: Include stress testing for large datasets.

T17.implementation_approach: Verify hints and solutions display functionality.
T17.notes: Ensure proper access control for solutions.

T18.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using containerization and cloud services.

from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

db = SQLAlchemy()

from app.database import db

class Problem(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'problems'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    difficulty = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.now())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.now(), onupdate=db.func.now())

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<Problem {self.id} - {self.title}>"

from app.database import db


class User(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'users'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), nullable=False, unique=True)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False, unique=True)
    password_hash = db.Column(db.String(128), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=db.func.now())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=db.func.now(), onupdate=db.func.now())

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<User {self.username}>"

# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems and improve their coding skills.

## Features

- Problem Library: A comprehensive library of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles and Progress Tracking: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.
- Leaderboard: Displays a ranking of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.
- Hints and Solutions: Provides hints and detailed solutions for problems to help users learn and improve.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
